name: totto_mercedes_f1_agent
description: Totto, a voice-first conversational fan agent for Mercedes Formula 1 covering race schedules, standings, history, official ticketing guidance, and merchandise order support.

variableDeclarations.name: favorite_team
variableDeclarations.description: The user's prioritized Formula 1 team context, defaulting to Mercedes.

variableDeclarations.name: is_mock_mode
variableDeclarations.description: Session state flag initialized by before_agent_callback for merchandise support flow configuration.

variableDeclarations.name: user_location
variableDeclarations.description: The user's city, region, or timezone used to localize Formula 1 race and session times.

variableDeclarations.name: order_number
variableDeclarations.description: The user's merchandise order number used in order lookups and support requests.

variableDeclarations.name: initialized
variableDeclarations.description: Session state marker indicating whether default variables have been initialized by before_agent_callback.
